[[No overall control]]{{efn|Liberal Democrat/Independent/Labour/Green coalition.}} | after_election = | after_party = }} The '''2026 Huntingdonshire District Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect all 52 members of [[Huntingdonshire District Council]] in [[England]].{{Cite web|title=Huntingdonshire District Council want to go ahead with local elections|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgnp1e8g54o|website=[[BBC News]]|date=2026-01-15|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}} Due to ongoing [[Upcoming structural changes to local government in England|local government reorganisation]], this will be the final election to Huntingdonshire District Council before it is abolished and replaced by a successor [[unitary authority]]. Elections to the successor authority are due to take place in 2027. == Background == In [[2022 Huntingdonshire District Council election|2022]], the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] lost the council to [[no overall control]].{{Cite news|title=Huntingdonshire result - Local Elections 2022|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2022/england/councils/E07000011|work=BBC News|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}} == Council composition == {| class="wikitable" |- ! colspan="3" | After 2022 election ! colspan="3" | Before 2026 election |- ! colspan="2" | Party !
